title: SAVED FROM
MINE ENEMIES
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: sunlit forest glade golden morning light
calm river flowing through sunlit pine forest
golden rays breaking through misty mountain trees
peaceful lake reflecting soft golden light
quiet countryside trail illuminated by morning sun

scenes.a: If voices of opposition are making you feel cornered today, take heart right here.
I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
Father, we thank You that our deliverance begins not with panic, but with praise.
Before the battle is even fought, You are already worthy of our full devotion.
Thank You for standing guard around us when hostility surrounds us on every side.
We place our complete trust in Your unfailing power, knowing You answer when we call.
